title: Fake website calls out reality of 'ghost student' problem at Minnesota colleges
supports: KSTP reported Normandale Community College had processed about 29,000 fraudulent or potentially fraudulent applications over several years and that administrators said roughly 31% of current applications were being flagged for review, down from about 42%.
KSTP reported Minnesota State flagged 2,696 fraudulent or potentially fraudulent financial-aid applications in the 2025-2026 academic year.
KSTP documented one identity-theft victim whose identity was used to obtain an approximately $9,000 federal student loan through a fraudulent Normandale enrollment.
does_not_support: Flagged or potentially fraudulent applications are not equivalent to completed fraud, unique perpetrators, enrollments, or dollars disbursed.
The 29,000 figure is an application-processing figure attributed to Normandale administration, not an audited statewide loss figure.
This source should remain a lead for an emerging higher-education/public-aid integrity family until Minnesota State, federal aid, audit, court, or data-practices records are captured.
